headline: CISA flags exploited Cisco BroadWorks flaw (now 4 outlets); OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12; Barracuda ESG due 11-13; two school districts hit

bullets.text: Changed: CISA has flagged Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 (XXE) as actively exploited, alongside Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder CVE-2026-111793; the story is now at 4 outlets. Both are in KEV with a federal due date of 11-24.

New: Barbour County Schools (West Virginia) cut internet during a suspected cyber incident, and Seminole County schools (Georgia) shut systems after one. Vanderbilt remains on lockdown after a BYOD-claimed ransomware attack (6 outlets).
Due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.
Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited in attacks (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13.

Microsoft patched 1,259 flaws, including exploited Outlook CVE-2026-124194 that may expose NTLMv2 hashes (KEV due 11-24). Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 is also due 11-24. Git patched a code-execution flaw in recursive clones.

Still active: N-able keeps hosted N-central offline after dozens of published zero-days; SAP patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws (ICM2SHELL); AhsayCBS and Xen Orchestra flaws are exploited; France blames Iran for sabotage at ~700 retail sites. The week ran 1.11x the 90-day average.

actions: Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Patch Cisco BroadWorks (CVE-2026-20320) and Openwave Webtop (CVE-2026-111793) and check for compromise; CISA confirms exploitation.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise.
Roll out Microsoft's November updates with priority on Outlook CVE-2026-124194, update Chrome, and update Git on build hosts.
Apply SAP's patches for the four CVSS 10.0 flaws, and patch or isolate AhsayCBS and Xen Orchestra servers.
N-central customers: follow N-able's guidance while the hosted service is offline and review remote-access logs.
